commands: Reviewed Playwright screenshots and text snapshots for admin and staff shipment surfaces.
Reviewed staff browser submit transcript for enabled/disabled button and confirmation dialog behavior.
Cross-checked negative states against unit and redteam reports for write-disabled, shop-not-authorized, OCR-failed, scan-rejected, idempotency conflict, and remote failure.
findings: Admin shipment workbench is visible, not blank, and presents the flow as ordered steps: waybill, device, order, shipment confirmation.
Staff H5 screen is visible on mobile viewport and separates waybill input/upload, device scan/input, order search, and final confirmation.
Empty state is explicit: staff search shows no pending candidates before matching data, and after successful submit the candidate list returns to empty.
Disabled state is explicit: staff submit is disabled until waybill, device, express, and selected order are complete.
Confirmation state is explicit: staff dialog shows masked order, full device number, and waybill before final submit.
Success state is explicit in the response transcript and database proof: masked waybill, remote message, source STAFF, and DISPATCHED assignment.

Negative states are covered by typed backend/frontend evidence: write-disabled, shop-not-authorized, OCR missing-file failure, invalid QR/scan rejection, idempotency conflict, and remote ship failure do not mutate assignment state.
Permission-denied is covered by server-side @PreAuthorize evidence and permission-gated admin/staff controls.
residual_risk: Independent visual review did not use real handset hardware; it used H5 mobile viewport screenshots and runtime text snapshots.
